name: Alter Self
description:
Concentration, up to 1 hour.

You transform your appearance. You decide what you look like, including your height, weight, facial features, sound of your voice, hair length, coloration, apparent ancestry and distinguishing characteristics, if any. You must remain humanoid and the changes in height and weight may be no more than 2 ft and 200 lbs, respectively.

While the spell lasts, you may spend an action to change your appearance in this way again.

Describe how you transform.
